verdict.rationale: Socketed CPU upgradeability with a multi-generation commitment is a fair question for a PC processor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a socket, a pin-compatible upgrade path, or any multi-generation platform support commitment. It describes the chip only as shipping in OEM Windows-on-Arm laptops and a mini-PC, with power envelopes left to OEMs.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can upgrade the CPU without replacing the platform — a documented socket with a stated multi-generation support commitment
